part5_ref: CA 5 — DCC Cannabis Unified License Search (the API behind it, resolved from the app's own config.js)

Carries premiseCounty, owner names, coordinates, licensing authority and the Adult-Use/Medicinal designation. Requires at least one search criterion, hence iterating the status list; the totals are summed and checked.

part5_ref: MI 5 — City of Grand Rapids 'Cannabis Licensed Locations' ArcGIS Experience app
note: CITY DATA, NOT A STATE ROSTER. It covers Grand Rapids only, so it must NOT be presented as Michigan's licence list. Kept because HANDOFF's site plan wants local pages: the same app carries sensitive-use buffers, allowed zone districts and 1000ft/2000ft licence buffers, which is exactly the local-rules material the city pages need. Michigan's state roster is still only in its eLicense portal.
